links.outcome: Reproducibility across repeated runs and robustness to greyscale input for signal counting
links.effect: High consistency across repeated runs (median absolute deviation 0.22), but aggregated MAE worsened to 1.60 on greyscale inputs, showing heavy reliance on colour.
links.quote: The model demonstrated high consistency across repeated runs (median absolute deviation of 0.22) and relied heavily on colour information, as the aggregated MAE worsened to 1.60 on greyscale inputs.

screen.reason: Evaluates off-the-shelf multimodal LLMs (Gemini, GPT, Claude) for zero- and few-shot counting of HER2/CEN17 FISH signals on a benchmark dataset of clinical slide images without testing specific deployment practices.
